# Big Think

> > Big Think is an educational platform featuring world-class thinkers discussing science, philosophy, and ideas that shape our world through videos and articles.

Big Think curates educational content across philosophy, science, and technology, featuring expert voices like Michelle Thaller from NASA and physicist Jim Al-Khalili. The platform combines video content with written articles to make complex ideas accessible to a broad audience.

## Key Topics

- Philosophy
- Physics & Quantum Mechanics
- Science Education
- Ethics
- Political Theory
- Cosmology & Aerospace
- Biology
- Language & Meaning
- Identity & Flourishing
- Knowledge & Epistemology
- Philosophy of Science
- Religion
- Health & Wellness
- NASA
- Video Content

## Core Hubs

- [Big Think - Smarter, Faster](https://bigthink.com): Big Think homepage: Learn from world's biggest thinkers via educational videos and articles
- [Latest Videos - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/videos): Video gallery featuring educational content on physics, astronomy, and science topics
- [Latest Articles - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/latest-articles): Article hub for discovering latest Big Think content across all topics
- [Our Mission - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/about): Big Think's mission statement and company vision for educational platform

## Philosophy & Ideas

- [Philosophy - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/philosophy): Philosophy topic hub with subtopics and content navigation
- [Ethics Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/ethics): Ethics content archive covering philosophy and ethical discussions
- [Political Theory Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/political-theory): Political theory and political philosophy content archive
- [Knowledge Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/knowledge): Knowledge content hub spanning philosophy, science, and business topics
- [Philosophy Of Science Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/philosophy-of-science): Philosophy of science archive covering epistemology and scientific method
- [Philosophy of Art Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/philosophy-of-art): Philosophy of art archive covering aesthetics and art theory

## Science & Technology

- [Science & Tech - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/science-tech): Science and technology topic hub with physics, biology, and engineering content
- [Physics Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/physics): Physics archive featuring quantum physics, cosmology, and science education
- [Biology Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/biology): Biology content archive with science articles and resources
- [Aerospace Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/aerospace): Aerospace topic archive covering space and aviation science
- [Health Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/health): Health and science content archive with wellness and medical articles

## Human Experience & Meaning

- [Meaning & Purpose Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/meaning-purpose): Meaning and purpose archive exploring existential questions and life purpose
- [Flourishing Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/flourishing): Flourishing topic archive covering well-being and human development
- [Identity Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/identity): Identity archive covering personal and cultural identity topics
- [Religion Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/religion): Religion topic archive with philosophy and content articles
- [Language Archives - Big Think](https://bigthink.com/t/language): Language studies archive covering philosophy and language topics
